overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: evidence of off-meeting deliberation was insufficient, and the May 10, 2012 notice was timely and complete. The Board was reminded that quorum communications must occur in open meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members discussed his special permit application with each other outside a noticed meeting, before and after the May 10, 2012 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: However, Mr. Cooper denies making these statements, and he and Chair Wedge both deny communicating with any other Board members regarding Mr. McNamara's application, outside of a noticed Board meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to properly post notice that it would deliberate on or vote on his application at the May 10, 2012 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: After speaking with Assistant Town Clerk Bissonnette, we believe that the notice was timely posted to the website, and included all of the elements required by G.L. c. 30A, § 20(b).
